reasons.plausibility: It aligns well with established corrosion science concerning oxide film stability and microstructural effects in steels under high-temperature salt exposure.
reasons.testability: Comparing as-received with homogenized Q235 samples under identical controlled environments is a direct and feasible method to reveal whether microstructural features mediate oxide film disruption.
reasons.usefulness: It presents a focused mechanism and proposes a clear experimental pathway, offering valuable insight into the high-temperature corrosion behavior of Q235 steel.
